author: Mark Atwood
text: [2026-05-11 scope-lock] Confirmed with Mark in interactive triage session: scope this bead to the 11 actual sloppy-Value fields only (Task: related_to, locations, virtual_locations, links, recurrence_rules, excluded_recurrence_rules, participants, alerts, time_zones; TaskList: default_alerts_with_time, default_alerts_without_time). The 2 PatchObject fields (Task: recurrence_overrides, localizations) round-trip Task → PatchObject → Task with a different oracle (JMAP PatchObject semantics, not RFC 8984 example JSON) and are out of scope here. File a separate small bead for PatchObject round-trip coverage if that's wanted later. Removing 'human' label.
